concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-plan-all-node]] - Node.js retrieval of the Plan-object collection through `gateway.plan.all()` in callback and Promise forms, without plan-creation, subscription-behavior, or enablement claims
warnings: Keep collection retrieval separate from plan creation and from subscription creation or lifecycle behavior.
Do not treat the See Also link as evidence that recurring billing or any plan is enabled for a merchant.
Treat the linked Plan response object and recurring-billing guide as navigation only unless each is fully read; do not import their fields or behavior.
